image_description: A close-up shot of a young man playing a bassoon. The image is framed tightly, focusing on the musician's face and the upper section of the instrument. The bassoon's bell (the large flared opening) is prominent in the foreground on the left, showing a dark reddish-brown wood interior with a lighter rim. The metal bocal (curved mouthpiece tube) extends from the instrument to the player's mouth, secured by a red neck strap. The background is a solid teal/green color.
